purpose: Set aside how a factor is judged while maintaining another point.
keywords: Whatever the result, trying has value.
Whatever the reason, an explanation is needed.
Whatever others think, I will continue.
restrictions: Often with 結果, 理由, or 評価.
mistake: It does not say the factor is unknown; it says it will not alter the conclusion.
